title: Gene Therapy for Osteoarthritis: Viral and Non-Viral Delivery Strategies.
snippet: Osteoarthritis (OA) is the most prevalent joint disease, which is pathologically characterized by articular cartilage degradation, chronic synovial inflammation, subchondral bone remodeling, and osteophyte formation.
